The documents do not specify a particular availability level that Harrowgate must meet. However, they do state that "Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance" [1].

There is no other availability level mentioned in the sources provided.

evidence.quote: Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance

items.question: Who is acquiring Harrowgate, and when is completion expected?
items.answer:
The documents state that Pellucid Holdings plc is acquiring Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1].

Completion of the acquisition is expected on 15 October 2026, subject to regulatory clearance. [1].

evidence.quote: Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc.
Completion is expected on 15 October 2026, subject to regulatory clearance.

items.question: Did Harrowgate give the change of control notice that the MSA requires, and how long before completion?
items.answer:
Harrowgate gave the change of control notice that the MSA requires. The notice was provided under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement [2].

Harrowgate provided the notice on 3 September 2026, and the completion was expected on 15 October 2026. This means the notice was given 42 days before completion. [1].

evidence.quote: Provider shall provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client in accordance with Clause 22.
Completion is expected on 15 October 2026, subject to regulatory clearance.

items.question: What service credit applies to downtime, and what monthly fee is it calculated on?
items.answer: The service credit for downtime is calculated as five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee for each full hour of unavailability below the 99.5% availability level [1]. The monthly subscription fee is USD 18,500 [2].

evidence.quote: For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee.
Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform.
